0022600224.text: The Utah Jazz host the Orlando Magic in the 12th game of their season, with Utah at 1-10, 15th in the West and 7 games back in the Northwest, and on a nine-game losing streak. Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) and Lauri Markkanen (hand fracture) are out for Utah, while Orlando, at 3-7 and 11th in the East, has Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain) and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain) out, with Jamal Cain (shoulder bruise) and Tristan da Silva (calf strain) listed as day-to-day game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Jazz lost their 2025-26 season series 0-2, including a 120-117 loss in Orlando on February 7, 2026.
